title: 測量実習・演習Ⅰ
subtitle: Surveying Practicum / Exercises I
keywords: Distance, Degree, Bearing 2.Error, Precision 3.Total Station 4.Distance survey, Control point survey 5.Declination survey, Leveling survey
educationalGoal: (1) Practice the surveying methods learned in Surveying I and Surveying II (2) Practice distance, control point, leveling and declination surveys and reports. (3) Reports are equivalent to company reports. Students will learn how to create data in required formats. (4) Students who master the topics in Surveying I/II and Surveying Practicum I/II will have the skills necessary for an Assistant Surveyor national license.
advice: Field training is implemented as a practice of active learning and [self-inspection], which is "comprehensive ability" learning. 1. Distance surveying: "Learn the basics of distance measurement." pacing, cloth tape measure, steel tape measure and distance measurement by total station. 2. Leveling: Learn how to handle automatic levels and electronic levels. Conduct small-scale direct leveling to understand the person. Understand survey error adjustments. 3. Handling the total station: Learn how to use the total station (TS) and how to handle equipment using the built-in programs. 4. Angular survey: Learn the basics of horizontal angle observation (double observation) by the single measurement method using a total station. With the measurement of eccentric elements as the subject. Then conduct angle observations around Building 2 and 3, and practice repeatedly so that observations can be made accurately. 5. (Advice): Moodle teaching materials (Surveying I, II) are useful for practical training and writing reports, so please refer to them. Please note that the schedule may change due to the weather, as the training will be held outdoors.
requiredKnowledge: In this course, students learn through practical skills the contents of the lectures learned in "Surveying I". Therefore, the contents of the classroom lectures (especially It is necessary to fully understand the advanced courses such as "Surveying II", "Surveying Practice/Exercise II", "Spatial Information Technology", etc. There is in addition, there are related subjects such as "Environmental Civil Engineering Experiments and Exercises B" and "Exercises in Geoinformatics".

achievementLevels.ideal: ●Distance surveying: Clear the standard achievement level, and the measurement results will appear in the order of the most accurate methods (steel tape measure, cloth tape measure, pacing). ●Leveling: Clear the standard achievement level, and in addition can perform leveling with high accuracy. ●Total station: clear the standard achievement level, plus advanced handling using the built-in program. ● Angular surveying: Clear the standard achievement level, and in addition, it is possible to perform angular surveying with high accuracy. ●Able to lead practical training independently and play a central role in the group.
achievementLevels.standard: ●Distance surveying: Understand surveying methods, and be able to accurately organize data and calculate accuracy. ●Leveling: Be able to understand the installation of automatic levels and electronic levels and carry out leveling. You can fill in the profile leveling and rise and fall method level book. ●Total station: Understand the basic usage of a total station. ● Angular surveying: A solid understanding of the installation and operation of a total station and the ability to perform angular surveying.
